#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""UCI engine that always resigns-level evaluation and plays the worst legal move it can."""
import sys

def main():
    pos_line = ""
    while True:
        line = sys.stdin.readline()
        if not line:
            break
        line = line.strip()
        if line == "uci":
            print("id name FakeEngine", flush=True)
            print("id author test", flush=True)
            print("option name Skill Level type spin default 20 min 0 max 20", flush=True)
            print("uciok", flush=True)
        elif line == "isready":
            print("readyok", flush=True)
        elif line.startswith("setoption"):
            pass
        elif line == "ucinewgame":
            pass
        elif line.startswith("position"):
            pos_line = line
        elif line.startswith("go"):
            # Provide a score so analyse() works, and a bestmove.
            # python-chess expects info lines for analyse.
            # We don't know if this is analyse (go depth) or play (go depth/time).
            # Always emit a mate score heavily favoring black, then a bestmove.
            # For bestmove we need a legal move. Parse position with chess if available.
            move = pick_move(pos_line)
            print("info depth 1 score mate -1", flush=True)
            print(f"bestmove {move}", flush=True)
        elif line == "quit":
            break

def pick_move(pos_line):
    try:
        import chess
        board = chess.Board()
        if "fen" in pos_line:
            # position fen <fen> [moves ...]
            parts = pos_line.split()
            # find fen
            i = parts.index("fen")
            fen = " ".join(parts[i+1:i+7])
            board = chess.Board(fen)
            if "moves" in parts:
                mi = parts.index("moves")
                for u in parts[mi+1:]:
                    board.push_uci(u)
        elif "startpos" in pos_line:
            parts = pos_line.split()
            if "moves" in parts:
                mi = parts.index("moves")
                for u in parts[mi+1:]:
                    board.push_uci(u)
        legal = list(board.legal_moves)
        if not legal:
            return "0000"
        # Prefer a move that hangs material / is stupid: just first legal is fine
        # if we want white to lose fast, pick something that doesn't capture if possible
        return legal[0].uci()
    except Exception:
        return "a2a3"

if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
EOF
